description: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions and increasing clean energy.
inclusion_criteria: Metric measures energy generated or saved from low-carbon sources or GHG emissions avoided or reduced.
external_reference: SDG 7 (Affordable and clean energy); SDG 13 (Climate action)

description: People living in housing they can afford.
inclusion_criteria: Metric counts people or households housed in below-market or supportive units during the period.
external_reference: SDG target 11.1 (Access to adequate safe and affordable housing)

description: Quality jobs and pathways into employment.
inclusion_criteria: Metric counts ongoing jobs created or sustained or people moving into employment.
external_reference: SDG target 8.5 (Full and productive employment and decent work)

inclusion_criteria: Metric counts people with recurring access to nutritious food (not one-time emergency support).
external_reference: SDG target 2.1 (Access to safe nutritious and sufficient food)
